<html lang="en">
	<head>
		<meta charset="UTF-8">
			<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
				<title>[[REPORT_TITLE]]</title>
			</head>
			<body style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 20px; background-color: #f9f9f9;">
				<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="MaximusLogo"/>
				<br/>
				<br/>
				<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background-color: white; border: 1px solid #ddd;">
					<!-- Header Section -->
					<tr style="background-color: #345888; color: white;">
						<td colspan="4" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; padding: 5px; text-align: left;">[[REPORT_TITLE]]</td>
					</tr>
					<!-- Status Section -->
					<tr style="background-color: #e7e6e6;">
						<td style="padding: 8px; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #ddd; width: 15%">Date:</td>
						<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #ddd;width: 40%">[[REPORT_DATE]]</td>
						<td style="padding: 8px; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #ddd;">Completed by:</td>
						<td style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #ddd;">[[REPORT_USER]]</td>
					</tr>
					<tr style="background-color: #e7e6e6;">
						<td colspan="1" style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #ddd; font-weight: bold;">Description:</td>
						<td colspan="3" style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #ddd;">[[REPORT_DESCP]]</td>
					</tr>
				</table>
				<br/>
				<!-- Main Table -->
		[[REPORT_TABLE]]
		
		<br/>
				<br/>
				<!-- Attachment Notes -->
				<span style="font-style: italic">[[FINAL_NOTE]]</span>
			</body>
		</html>
